items.title: 2.11 Mantiq par mabni istidlal aur inference (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of logic-based reasoning and inference (PDF 33).

blocks.text: Mantiq par mabni istidlal aur inference maloom haqaiq se mantiq ke qawaid qadam ba qadam follow kar ke nataij nikalne ke tareeqe hain. Istidlal masail hal karne, faisle karne aur maloomat ki tasdeeq mein madad deta, aur mantiqi inference nataij ko durust aur qabil-e-aitbaar banata hai. Yeh haqeeqi duniya ke pecheeda masail hal karne ke liye zaroori aur tanqeedi soch (critical thinking) behtar karta hai.

Mantiqi inference maloom maloomat se mantiqi qawaid par chal kar naye haqaiq nikalne ka amal hai. Maslan 'Tamam insaan faani hain' aur 'Socrates insaan hai' se hum nateeja nikalte hain 'Socrates faani hai'. Agar muqaddimat (premises, ibtidai haqaiq) sach hon to nateeja sach hai. Inference riyazi, computer science aur artificial intelligence mein saboot par mabni faislon ke liye use hota hai.

Deduction aisa istidlal hai jo aam haqaiq se shuru ho kar khaas nateeje tak pohanchta hai, if-then jaise qawaid use kar ke. Maslan 'Agar barish ho to zameen geeli hoti hai' aur 'Barish ho rahi hai' se 'Zameen geeli hai' nikalta hai. Deduction qabil-e-aitbaar hai kyunke muqaddimat sach hon to nateeja yaqeenan sach hota hai, aur computers ise masail hal karne aur sawalon ke jawab dene ke liye use karte hain.

blocks.prompt: 'Agar number 4 se taqseem ho to jufat hai. 12, 4 se taqseem hota hai.' Kya nateeja nikalta hai? Kya ulti daleel 'Agar number jufat ho to 4 se taqseem hota hai' durust hai?
blocks.explanation: 12 jufat hai. Ulti daleel durust nahi: 6 jufat hai lekin 4 se taqseem nahi, is liye 'to' wala hissa jaanna 'agar' wala hissa sabit nahi karta.

items: Inference: maloom haqaiq se mantiqi qawaid par naye haqaiq.
Deduction: aam qaida aur milti haqeeqat se khaas nateeja.
Durust deduction mein sach muqaddimat sach nateeja yaqeeni banate.
